experiment.metric: Mean Absolute Error on held-out ratings (lower is better)

result.conclusion: Statistically significant difference (p=0.0000). Content-Based approach has lower prediction error (deploy).

honest_caveats: Experiment simulated on historical data — real A/B test would measure live engagement
MAE on held-out ratings is a proxy metric — actual click/engagement rate may differ
Cold-start users excluded — results apply only to users with 20+ ratings

genre_count_vs_rating.insight: Genre count has 0.036 correlation with rating (significant)

high_vs_low_rater_volume.insight: High-rating users give 93 ratings on average vs 274 for low-rating users — 0.3x more engaged

recency_vs_rating.insight: Item recency has 0.084 correlation with rating
